name: OpenWork
description: AI coworker for you and your team. Run agents, skills, and MCPs. Open-source alternative to Claude Cowork/Codex.

openwork-host.name: OpenWork Host
openwork-host.description: Orchestrator running opencode + openwork-server in a single container

OPENWORK_TOKEN.description: Client bearer token for connecting OpenWork apps

OPENWORK_HOST_TOKEN.description: Host/admin token for approvals and admin APIs

OPENWORK_APPROVAL_MODE.description: Approval mode: 'auto' (auto-approve all) or 'manual' (require host approval)

OPENWORK_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in ms for manual approval requests

OPENWORK_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated CORS origins or '*' for all

OPENWORK_DATA_DIR.description: Persistent data directory inside the container
